subject: general
question: Seven boxes V, W, X, Y, Z, Q and R are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order. No box is kept above Z. Only three boxes are kept between Z and W. Only one box is kept between V and R. R is kept immediately above W. Only four boxes are kept between V and X. Q is kept at some place above Y. Which box is kept second below Q?
solution:
Seven boxes V, W, X, Y, Z, Q and R are kept one over the other but not necessarily in the same order.

 
• No box is kept above Z.
 
• Only three boxes are kept between Z and W.
 
• Only one box is kept between V and R.
 
• R is kept immediately above W.
 
• Only four boxes are kept between V and X.
 
• Q is kept at some place above Y.

The Final Arrangement is,

 
 

 
 
Z

 
 
 

 
 
V

 
 
 

 
 
Q

 
 
 

 
 
R

 
 
 

 
 
W

 
 
 

 
 
Y

 
 
 

 
 
X

 
 
 

 

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 4"**
